contract.url: stable URL string; raw shell commands not allowed
contract.tabOwnership: TabID + SessionID explicit; no implicit global current tab
contract.fileURI: file:// not allowed; use amitia:// via ResourceURI
contract.waitStrategy: Provider-execution concern; contract accepts URL only
contract.timeout: Execution-level concern; contract accepts URL only
contract.result: BrowserNavigationResult with SessionID, TabID, URL, FinalURL, Title, StatusCode
